title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Announced a new Worldwide Battery Replacement Program for 13-inch MacBook Pro models
text:
April 21, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Announced a new Worldwide Battery Replacement Program for 13-inch MacBook Pro models 
For 13-inch MacBook Pro models, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) announced a new worldwide battery replacement program, that do not have a Touch Bar. The affected models of MacBook were manufactured between October 2016 and October 2017. 
The company says that a limited number of these MacBook Pro models, units feature a component, that can fail and in reaction can cause the built-in battery to expand. According to the company, it is not a safety issue, and Apple Inc. (AAPL) will replace all eligible batteries. 
The affected customers, to get theses replacement done, who are eligible for a new battery, will need to visit an Apple Authorized Service Provider, make an appointment at an Apple retail store, or mail their device into an Apple Repair Center after initiating a repair with Apple Support.
